newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Fuel Oil- Firm offers help support prices.
newsitem.headline: Asia Fuel Oil- Firm offers help support prices.

text.p: The high sulphur fuel oil market firmed in line with crude gains later Thursday and firm offers, traders said.
But activities were scarce as buyers remained sidelined, anticipating weaker prices later this week, they said.
"The fundamentals are still weak," one trader said.
"There are more offers than bids," he said.
Offers for March loading supplies were indicated between $100-$102.50 against no bids.
Early Thursday, there were at least two offers from majors for two separate cargoes for loading March 3-7 and March 16-20.
One major was later heard to have lowered its offers but still there were no takers.
Traders said Chinese buyers were still quiet and are taking a relax stance.
They Indian demand for February would helped to take out some lengths in the region, limiting the supplies coming to the far east from the Middle East.
Thailand is expected to award its tender to buy 10,000 tones of 1.0 percent sulphur grde fuel oil for delivery March 3-7 on Friday.
LSWR prices fell as more supplies take their toll, putting pressure on levels.
(Prices in dollars per tonne, unless stated)
